name: GRB2 associated binding protein 2

function.text: GAB2 encodes GRB2-associated-binding protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase adaptor activity and phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate binding. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
